scientific_role.name: sixth-region external geographic validation
scientific_role.purpose: Test whether conclusions developed on the frozen 50-city, five-region benchmark transfer to an entirely withheld, geographically contiguous Central-China region.

time_protocol.reason_for_2022_12_support: Provide complete historical context for early-2023 targets; December 2022 is input support only, not an evaluation year.

external_spatial_2023_2024.meaning: Entirely unseen region during the same covered calendar period used for model development.

external_joint_2025.meaning: Entirely unseen region plus future-year shift.

external_temporal.reason: The external region is never seen during training, so a seen-region/future-time external condition does not exist.

data_boundary.air_quality: Same CNEMC/QuotSoft source, station QC policy, city aggregation, target validity rules, and units as the frozen 50-city benchmark.
data_boundary.meteorology: Same ERA5 variables, pressure levels, physical derivations, hourly alignment, and city extraction policy as the frozen benchmark.
data_boundary.feature_schema: Exactly the already-frozen observed-sequence feature schema; no feature may be added or modified using external-region results.

checkpoint_and_preprocessing.checkpoint_rule: For every trainable model and outer fold k, use the already-frozen fold-k best checkpoint selected solely by the original outer VALIDATION cities under 2023-2024 data.
checkpoint_and_preprocessing.fold_specific_input_transform: Use the original fold-k FIT-only imputation median, transform center, and transform scale. External rows contribute zero statistics.
checkpoint_and_preprocessing.fold_specific_target_transform: Use the original fold-k FIT-only target mean/std for model-output de-standardization. External target values contribute zero statistics.

models.hyperparameters: exactly frozen from the formal benchmark

estimands.trained_model_exposure_unit: one already-trained fold-specific single model x one external physical task row
estimands.primary_pooling: Pool all single-model fold exposures within scenario for global risk; do not average the 10 fold predictions into an ensemble forecast.
estimands.per_city_pooling: Pool the 10 fold-specific single-model exposures within each external city.
estimands.persistence_handling: Evaluate persistence once per physical task row; do not manufacture 10 duplicated fold exposures for uncertainty.

external_replication_questions: Q1 ranking external validity: does the architecture ordering from the five-region benchmark persist in the sixth withheld region?
Q2 future degradation replication: from External-Spatial 2023-2024 to External-Joint 2025, does normalized difficulty increase?
Q3 architecture-response reproducibility: do the strongest benchmark architectures retain their relative advantage under genuine external geography?

analysis_stopping_rule.data_quality_failure_policy: If a frozen city fails a pre-model source-availability/QC gate, stop. Any replacement requires a documented protocol v2 created before running any model inference on external data.

public_rebuild_note: Frozen protocol rules only. Historical internal audit receipts and observations are not distributed; users reconstruct and audit their own inputs.
